title: PACP: Glowing Ores Addon
description: A PACP add-on that makes ores glow in the dark.
body:
## **From the shadows, they rise**

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88faeec1d8eb5a0425bf2b9f6a930ee1bba51cc7_0.webp)

A companion add-on for PACP that gives ores a glowing effect, making them visible and vibrant even in the darkest caves. Designed to be used alongside [PACP](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pacp) for a complete Programmer Art experience.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a999b935c29d9499ffe97a6192448e3e93597c8b.png)
